engagement.rules_of_engagement: No denial of service; no physical access; report critical findings within 24 hours

findings.title: SQL Injection in Login Form
findings.description: SQL injection vulnerability found in the login form parameter 'username'. Allows authentication bypass.
findings.technical_details: Parameter 'username' in login endpoint is not properly sanitized. SQLi payload: ' OR 1=1--'
findings.remediation_long: Refactor all database queries to use parameterized queries. Use ORM with built-in protection. Input validation on all user inputs.

findings.title: Unquoted Service Path
findings.description: Windows service with unquoted path allowing DLL hijacking.
findings.technical_details: Service 'UpdateService' has path 'C:\Program Files\Update\update.exe'. Space in path allows planting malicious DLL.
findings.remediation_short: Quote the service path in the registry
findings.remediation_long: Modify the service registry key to quote the executable path: 'C:\Program Files\Update\update.exe'. Restart service.

findings.title: Default Credentials on Router
findings.description: Router admin interface accessible with default credentials 'admin/admin'.
findings.technical_details: HTTP management interface on 192.168.1.1:8080 uses default credentials.
findings.remediation_short: Change default credentials to strong, unique password
findings.remediation_long: Access router administration at 192.168.1.1:8080 and change admin password. Document in asset inventory.

attack_chains.title: Initial Access → Privilege Escalation → Data Exfiltration

steps.action: Gain initial access via router admin interface using default credentials
Plant DLL via unquoted service path for privilege escalation
steps.notes: DLL planted; service restart required for escalation

steps.action: Exfiltrate data via SQL injection from internal database
steps.notes: SQLi used to extract customer records

engagement.executive_summary: During the red team engagement against Acme Corporation, three significant vulnerabilities were identified that, when chained together, enable an attacker to exfiltrate sensitive customer data. The engagement lasted 31 days and resulted in a critical severity cumulative risk. Immediate remediation of the SQL injection vulnerability is recommended as the highest priority, followed by the unquoted service path and default credentials. Overall organizational security posture has been measurably improved by identifying and addressing these findings.
